title: Page 8
content_zh:
两人苦恼的左思右想了好半晌，最后拍板，既然这也不行，那也不是，唯一能做的便是挟军功以令天子。

只要他们能够立下泼天的功劳，皇上哪里还会计较那丁点的小事，所以这回他们不但得要将那些吃里扒外的狗东西都给揪出来，更要将云泸国那些妄想着谋夺旁人领土的贼人打退百里之外，让他们不敢再轻易再来捋虎须。

江成玉瞧着褚靖南那一心为汪袭绿谋划的认真模样，心中禁不住一黯，难怪绿丫头虽然表面总是佯装不在乎，心里却始终放不下这个男人，这个男人一旦认真起来，的确有教女人魂牵梦萦的魅力啊！

想到这儿，他的心仿佛被人扯弄似的微微生疼。

他还以为他终究可以等到一个机会，等到袭绿对褚靖南完全死心之际，便能光明正大的照顾他们母子俩……

也不知道从什么时候开始，他已不再只把袭绿当成妹妹看待，他心中曾经暗暗希冀，再等宝儿大一些，就向她提出成亲的要求，可现在瞧来，她和褚靖南依然郎情妾意，让人哪有一丝见缝插针的机会。

罢罢罢，不属于自己的终究是不属于自己，若是袭绿能活得不要那么抑郁，他瞧了终究是开心的，便……这样吧！

他会全心帮着褚靖南立下不世的功劳，保汪袭绿一世的富贵幸福，这样他便可以放心地藏着这个秘密，放心地独自一人行医天下了。

第9章(1)

长长的车队，马车一辆接着一辆往军营的方向而来，三十万石的粮草竟真的如期而至。

赵修缘更加烦躁不安，他本想着，能在短短三天之内弄到三十万石的粮草，这得要有多少的银钱和人面啊！

那个殷氏不过是个女人家，哪能有这么大的本事，而且这几日不知道是怎么了，他再也收不到从京城来的消息，无论是朝廷方面还是暗桩送来的，让他对目前的情况犹如雾里看花，不清不楚的。

他知道自己这几日的所作所为早已让褚老将军生了疑，若然让褚家这一老一小的回到京城去，只怕自己小命就要不保，想来便连三皇子也保不住他。

更何况，他早已对云泸国的密探信誓旦旦的说边关粮草已所剩无多，现在莫名多出三十万石，偏偏褚老头子又看得紧，别说密信，只怕就连只鸽子都飞不出去，压根无法通风报信。

“赵副将，小女子幸不辱命，这三十万石的粮草物归原处，还请副将点收。”

见众兵士全都透着松了口气的神情，汪袭绿感激的看向押着粮草而来的江成玉，还有特地赶来帮忙的江成恪、江成云三兄弟。

“可得点好了，别到时短了、少了，又或者被烧了，又要指控旁人是别的国家派来的细作。”

这话夹枪带棒还兼指桑骂槐，弄得赵修缘立刻就沉下脸，还当真上前几步，朝着自己的亲信挥了挥手，让他们对前头几辆马车上的粮草细细检查了起来。

本以为就算没混水摸鱼，也会以次充好，但没想到查了几辆车都是上好的粮食，赵修缘即使暗恨在心中，也得要收下这些军粮。

若是真让褚家带着大军打胜了这场仗，褚家一直是支持皇长子的，那么情况绝对会对三皇子非常不利，既是如此，只怕就算要冒些风险，他还是得要对这些粮草动些手脚，绝对不能让褚家打胜这场仗。

“可以了！”

“既然当初粮草被劫只是大将军的缓兵之计，那么大将军自然也就摆脱了奸细的嫌疑，倒是末将浅薄，才会造成这样的误会，现在又是褚老将军重掌帅印，那么夫人就安心待在营内，等待将军归来吧。”

汪袭绿瞧着赵修缘那变脸的速度，简直是叹为观止，可瞧着他眸心隐隐闪着的愤怒和恨意，只怕还有所图。

“赵将军……”她正想着看看能不能探出些什么，便见江成玉朝她眨了眨眼，她虽然总觉得好像有哪儿不对劲，但仍聪明的不再在这件事上琢磨，而是说道：“三表哥，随我来吧，我还有些家里的事想问你。”

江成玉颔首应好，可是才迈了一步，便被赵修缘给拦了住。

汪袭绿顿时变了脸色，有些不悦地朝着赵修缘问道：“你这是什么意思？！”

“夫人怎么这样问我呢？不是老将军下令要严禁闲杂人等进出军机重地的吗？”

这几日他被留在军营之中，等闲不能外出一步，心中早就憋了火气，如今又见粮草运了过来，心里早就火急火燎的怕坏了三皇子的好事，自己的前程富贵不保。

他瞪着汪袭绿，就忍不住将所有的错处都往她的身上堆去。若不是她，这大营之中他早就是说一不二的主，想要和京城或云泸的人通个气，也不会难如登天了。

“小妹，既然赵副将不许，那也无所谓的，等到一切事了，咱们再叙也是一样的。”

汪袭绿狐疑的瞧着难得这样好说话的江成玉，心中不断盘算着这厮到底在打着什么鬼主意。

“别想那么多了，如今粮草已齐，不日便是两军决战之时，你也快快回去休息，免得糟蹋了我好不容易为你养好的身子。”

听江成玉这样说，汪袭绿更怀疑了，心里猫抓似的想要知道江成玉究竟背着她在搞什么。

毕竟江成玉对行军打仗这种事向来没什么兴趣，如今眸中竟闪现着一股子灿亮的跃跃欲试，真教她是一头雾水。

可偏偏江成玉却不给他再问的机会，脚跟俐落的一旋，一句话不再多说的就走了。

江成玉走了，汪袭绿自然也无心多留，正准备招呼着紫云和半屏回去时，就见赵修缘站在不远处瞪着她，他身上散发的那股子寒意，让她不由得打了一个寒颤。

“小姐，那厮肯定在打什么坏主意。”半屏没好气的道。

汪袭绿其实也是这么想的，可是她又能怎么办呢？

有时夜深人静，她都会忍不住的想褚靖南若是再不快些回来，她和祖父只怕也撑不了太久了。

毕竟老将军的名号，一时震慑自然可行，可老将军毕竟只有虚衔在身，又在赵修缘的刻意主导下，这两日军营之中已经渐渐有些风言风语传了出来了，而且大多都是对褚老将军不利的。

说他霸权是为了替自己的孙子湮灭罪证，也有说他根本早就被云泸收买，只等着将家人从京城中接出来，便要投靠云泸。

这些话她敢拍胸脯保证，绝对是出于赵修缘的口中，只可惜她在军营之中，也是举步艰难，虽然有祖父护着，可每每她只要走近兵士们，就会有人出来阻拦她。

想到这里，汪袭绿脑海就忍不住地浮现出褚靖南的脸庞，一想起他，她的眼眶也开始热热的，要不是极力克制，只怕便要失态。

他……究竟什么时候才要回来？

这些天过去了，若是他真的平安无事，为何没半点消息呢？

担忧和思念让汪袭绿这几天都没有睡好，身子有些虚软，在半屏的搀扶下，她回到了大帐，褚靖南的气息仿佛还残留着。

此时此刻，她终于不用再继续端着那冷静自持的模样，她跌坐在椅子上，几乎失力，她再不能冷静的说出一句话来，只是默默垂泪。

半屏见她这模样，也忍不住心疼。“小姐……小姐……哭出来了，也好。”

一直跟在主子身边服侍的她，哪能不知道自家主子的苦，以前是求而不得，现在好不容易两心相许，却生死难料。
content_en:
The two thought about it distressedly for a long time, and finally made a decision. Since this is not possible, that is not the case. The only thing they can do is to use military merit to win over the emperor.

As long as they can make great contributions, the emperor will not care about trivial matters, so this time they not only have to find out all the scoundrels, but also repel those thieves from Yunlu Kingdom who want to seize other people's territory from hundreds of miles away, so that they don't dare to stroke the tiger's beard easily again.

Jiang Chengyu couldn't help but feel sad when he looked at Chu Jingnan's serious look of planning for Wang Xilu. No wonder the green girl always pretended not to care on the surface, but she couldn't let go of this man in her heart. Once this man got serious, he did have the charm to make women dream of him!

Thinking of this, his heart ached slightly as if someone was tugging at him.

He thought that he could finally wait for an opportunity, and when Xi Lu gave up on Chu Jingnan, he could take care of their mother and son in a fair and just manner...

He didn't know since when, he no longer only regarded Xi Lu as his sister. He had secretly hoped that when Bao'er was older, he would ask her to get married. But now it seems that she and Chu Jingnan are still in love with each other, and there is no chance for anyone to sneak in.

Come on, whatever doesn't belong to you doesn't belong to you after all. If Xi Lu can live a less depressed life, he will be happy after all, so... so be it!

He will wholeheartedly help Chu Jingnan make immortal contributions and ensure Wang Xilu's wealth and happiness for the rest of his life, so that he can safely hide this secret and practice medicine alone in the world.

Chapter 9(1)

A long convoy and carriages came one after another in the direction of the military camp. Three hundred thousand shi of food and grass actually arrived as expected.

Zhao Xiuyuan was even more irritable and restless. He originally thought that if he could get 300,000 stones of food and grass in just three days, how much money and face would it cost!

That Yin family is just a woman, how can she have such great ability, and I don't know what happened these days. He no longer receives news from the capital, whether it is from the court or from secret posts, which makes him feel like he is seeing flowers in the fog and is unclear about the current situation.

He knew that what he had done in the past few days had already made General Chu suspicious. If he allowed the whole Chu family, the oldest and the youngest, to return to the capital, he would be in danger of losing his life. Even the third prince would not be able to save him.

What's more, he had already sworn to the spies of the Yunlu Kingdom that there was not much food and grass left at the border, and now there was an inexplicable extra three hundred thousand dan, but Old Man Chu was paying close attention to it. Not to mention the secret message, he was afraid that even a pigeon would not be able to fly out, and there would be no way to report the message.

"Lieutenant General Zhao, my little lady is lucky to have lived up to her command. These three hundred thousand stones of food and grass are returned to their original places. I would like to ask you, Lieutenant General, to take some of them."

Seeing that all the soldiers looked relieved, Wang Xilu looked gratefully at Jiang Chengyu, who was bringing food and grass, and the three brothers Jiang Chengke and Jiang Chengyun who came specially to help.

"It's better to have some money. Don't be short of time, less money, or get burned, and then accuse others of being spies sent by other countries."

These words, carrying a gun and a stick, also pointed at Sang and Huai, made Zhao Xiuyuan immediately darken his face. He actually took a few steps forward, waved to his cronies, and asked them to carefully inspect the grain and grass on the first few carriages.

I thought that even if I didn't fish in troubled waters, I would just pass it off as inferior goods, but I didn't expect that several trucks were full of good food. Zhao Xiuyuan had to accept these military rations even though he secretly hated them.

If the Chu family is really allowed to lead the army to win this battle, and the Chu family has always supported the eldest son of the emperor, then the situation will definitely be very unfavorable to the third prince. In this case, even if he has to take some risks, he will still have to do something with the food and grass, and the Chu family must not be allowed to win this battle.

"That's it!"

"Since the robbery of grain and grass was just the general's plan to delay the attack, the general was naturally freed from the suspicion of being a spy. It is the general's shallowness that caused such a misunderstanding. Now that General Chu is back in command, my wife can stay in the camp with peace of mind and wait for the general's return."

Wang Xilu was amazed when he saw the speed at which Zhao Xiuyuan changed his face, but looking at the anger and hatred faintly flashing in his eyes, he was afraid that he had something up his sleeve.

"General Zhao..." She was just thinking to see if she could find out anything, when she saw Jiang Chengyu blinking at her. Although she always felt that something was wrong, she was still smart enough not to think about it anymore. Instead, she said: "Third cousin, come with me. I still have some things at home that I want to ask you."

Jiang Chengyu nodded in greeting, but as soon as he took a step, he was stopped by Zhao Xiuyuan.

Wang Xilu's expression suddenly changed, and he asked Zhao Xiuyuan with some displeasure, "What do you mean?!"

"Why are you asking me this, madam? Didn't the old general give an order to strictly prohibit idlers from entering or leaving military aircraft areas?"

He had been kept in the military camp for the past few days and could not go out for a while. He had already suppressed his anger. Now that he saw the food and grass being delivered, he was already anxious and worried about ruining the good things of the third prince and his own future and wealth.

He stared at Wang Xilu and couldn't help but blame all his faults on her.If it hadn't been for her, he would have been the absolute leader in this camp, and it wouldn't be as difficult to communicate with people in the capital or Yunlu.

"Little sister, since Vice General Zhao doesn't allow it, it doesn't matter. It will be the same if we talk about it after everything is settled."

Wang Xilu looked suspiciously at Jiang Chengyu, who was rarely so talkative, and kept wondering what the hell this guy was planning.

"Don't think so much. Now that we have all the food and grass, it will be the decisive battle between the two armies in the near future. You should go back and rest quickly, so as not to ruin the body that I have worked hard to maintain for you."

Hearing what Jiang Chengyu said, Wang Xilu became even more suspicious, wanting to know what Jiang Chengyu was doing behind her back.

After all, Jiang Chengyu had never been interested in things like marching and fighting, but now there was a bright eagerness to try in his eyes, which really made her confused.

But Jiang Chengyu didn't give him a chance to ask again. He turned his heels neatly and left without saying another word.

Jiang Chengyu left, and Wang Xilu naturally had no intention of staying any longer. When he was about to greet Ziyun and Banping to go back, he saw Zhao Xiuyuan standing not far away and staring at her. The chill radiating from his body made her shiver.

"Miss, that guy must have some bad ideas." Banping said angrily.

Wang Xilu actually thought so too, but what could she do?

Sometimes in the dead of night, she couldn't help but think that if Chu Jingnan didn't come back soon, she and her grandfather might not be able to survive for long.

After all, the title of the old general can be used to frighten him for a while, but the old general only has an empty title after all, and under Zhao Xiuyuan's deliberate leadership, some rumors have gradually spread in the military camp in the past two days, and most of them are unfavorable to the old general Chu.

It is said that his hegemony is to annihilate the evidence of his grandson's crime. Others say that he has been bribed by Yun Lu for a long time, and he is just waiting to take his family out of the capital before joining Yun Lu.

She dared to pat her chest and guarantee that these words definitely came from Zhao Xiuyuan's mouth. Unfortunately, she was having difficulty in the military camp. Although she was protected by her grandfather, whenever she approached the soldiers, someone would come out to stop her.

Thinking of this, Wang Xilu couldn't help but picture Chu Jingnan's face in her mind. When she thought of him, her eyes began to heat up. If she hadn't tried her best to restrain herself, she might have lost her composure.

When...will he come back?

These days have passed. If he is really safe and sound, why is there no news at all?

Worry and longing kept Wang Xilu from sleeping well in the past few days, and her body was a little weak. With the support of the half-screen, she returned to the tent, and Chu Jingnan's breath seemed to still linger.

At this moment, she finally no longer had to maintain her calm and self-possessed look. She fell down on the chair and almost lost all strength. She could no longer say a word calmly and just cried silently.

Seeing her like this half the screen, I couldn't help but feel sad."Miss...Miss...it's okay if you cry."

How could she not know the suffering of her master, who has always been by his side to serve him? In the past, he could not get what he asked for, but now they finally agree, but life and death are uncertain.
